dedupeText: minimalist pink album cover pink minimalist typography parental advisory soft colors clean design the central text is the primary focal point against the expansive pink background the parental advisory label acts as a secondary contrasting element in the bottom right the two shades of pink in the title create a subtle visual rhythm the solid background provides a clean uncluttered canvas for the typographic elements minimalist solid color background with centrally placed two tone serif text and a standard warning label in the bottom right

recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist album cover featuring a solid light pink background with a central, horizontally aligned title in a serif font, using two shades of pink. A 'Parental Advisory' label is positioned in the bottom right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The central text is the primary focal point against the expansive pink background.
The 'Parental Advisory' label acts as a secondary, contrasting element in the bottom right.
The two shades of pink in the title create a subtle visual rhythm.
The solid background provides a clean, uncluttered canvas for the typographic elements.
coreInvariants: Serif typeface for the main title.
Two distinct shades of pink used for the main title.
Black and white 'Parental Advisory' label in the bottom right.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main text is centrally positioned horizontally, slightly above the vertical midpoint, occupying approximately 20% of the canvas width and 5% of its height. The 'Parental Advisory' label is small, located in the bottom right corner, taking up about 10% of the width and 10% of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The main text 'SWAG II' serves as the primary visual anchor due to its central placement and size.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn directly to the central text, then might briefly glance at the 'Parental Advisory' label in the corner, before returning to the main title. The overall movement is static and direct.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Abundant negative space, primarily the light pink background, surrounds the central text and the corner label, creating a sense of calm and focus on the few elements present.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: The light pink background (hex: #FADDE3) is the dominant color, establishing a soft and minimalist mood.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: The black of the 'Parental Advisory' label provides the strongest contrast, drawing attention to its warning.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: The two shades of pink in the main title (lighter pink: hex: #F1D1D8, darker pink: hex: #D9A8B6) act as subtle accents, creating visual interest within the text itself.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The colors are generally desaturated and light in value, contributing to the soft and gentle aesthetic. The black of the advisory label is a stark exception.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to light pinks, black, and white.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Serif, old-style or transitional, with moderate contrast and bracketed serifs.
letterConstructionRules: The 'SWAG' portion is in a lighter pink.
The 'II' portion is in a darker pink.

composition.position: horizontally centered, slightly above vertical midpoint

treatment.fill: two-tone pink (lighter for first part, darker for second)

typesetting.case: all caps for 'PARENTAL ADVISORY', mixed case for 'EXPLICIT CONTENT'

composition.relationshipToImage: placed directly on the background, within a black rectangle

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a classic serif for the main title and a modern sans-serif for the advisory label.
graphicDevices: Solid black rectangle for the 'Parental Advisory' label.

preserve: Serif style for the main title
Two-tone color application for the main title
avoid: Outline or shadow effects on the main title
Any colors other than the specified pinks, black, and white

candidateDirections.reason: Classic serif with good legibility and moderate contrast, similar to the original.
Another widely available serif with a friendly, readable character, suitable for display.
A more elegant and high-contrast serif, could provide a slightly more sophisticated feel while maintaining the aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid, uniform light pink background (hex: #FADDE3).
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the main text 'SWAG II' horizontally centered, slightly above the vertical midpoint. Use a serif font, with 'SWAG' in hex: #F1D1D8 and 'II' in hex: #D9A8B6. In the bottom right corner, place a black rectangle containing the 'Parental Advisory Explicit Content' text in white, using a bold sans-serif font, with 'PARENTAL ADVISORY' in all caps and 'EXPLICIT CONTENT' in mixed case.

verificationChecks: Is the background a uniform light pink?
Is the main text a serif font, uppercase, and two-toned pink?
Is the 'Parental Advisory' label correctly positioned and styled (black background, white sans-serif text)?
Are there any unintended graphic elements or textures?

adjustableVariables: Specific shades of pink for the text and background
Exact serif font for the main title
Exact sans-serif font for the 'Parental Advisory' label
Size and precise vertical position of the main title
Size and precise corner padding of the 'Parental Advisory' label

mustAchieve: Clear legibility of all text elements.
A soft, inviting color palette with a strong contrasting warning label.

postGenerationChecks: Confirm the background is a single, flat color.
Verify the main text uses two distinct pinks and a serif typeface.
Ensure the 'Parental Advisory' label is present, correctly colored, and positioned.
Check for any unintended gradients, textures, or shadows.
Confirm all text is legible and free from distortion.
recipe.reuseFormula: Minimalist solid color background with centrally placed, two-tone serif text and a standard warning label in the bottom right.
